source_row.extraction_instructions: Single /meetings page with five sections: ASH Annual Meeting and four Highlights of ASH programmes (North America in four cities, Asia-Pacific, MEMENA, Latin America). Each section states the NEXT edition in a 'taking place <dates>, in <City>, <Country>' sentence; programme pages still carry last edition's text (Kuala Lumpur, Istanbul), so dates/venue are anchored on the current edition's date line. Fees are USD HTML grids on /registration (/registration-information for the Annual Meeting), used only when the page names the edition year. Annual Meeting late-breaking abstract deadline is read from /abstracts.
